title: Mystic Forest Encounter
description: A blue-skinned tiefling mage with horns and glowing eyes levitates above a forest path, casting a swirling vortex of blue magical energy and light. In the foreground, a pale woman with face tattoos holds a red umbrella while a small green creature perches on her shoulder, both observing the spectacle.
prompt: A blue-skinned tiefling sorcerer with curved horns, glowing eyes, and a long coat levitates in a misty forest, casting a powerful swirling vortex of bright blue magical energy and runes that spiral around him. In the foreground, a woman with face tattoos and yellow eyes holds a large red umbrella as a small green gremlin-like creature sits on her shoulder, both standing on a winding forest path surrounded by floating red and yellow leaves, in a detailed comic book illustration style.
